---
title: Examples
# Re-run the examples on every build, so their output always matches the current code.
freeze: false
---

Every example on this page runs while the documentation is built. The output you see is what the current version of the code prints.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import subprocess
import sys


def console(*args: str) -> None:
    """Run ``hello-world`` with ``args`` and show it like a terminal session."""
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "hello_world_python_library", *args],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    command = " ".join(["$ hello-world", *args])
    output = (result.stdout + result.stderr).rstrip("\n")
    print(f"```console\n{command}\n{output}\n```\n")
    print(f"Exit code: `{result.returncode}`\n")
```

## Print the greeting

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
console()
```

## Show the installed version

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
console("--version")
```

## Get help

`-h` and `--help` do the same thing. The [CLI reference](../reference/cli/index.qmd) lists every option.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
console("--help")
```

## Pass an option it doesn't know

An unknown option prints the usage line and an error to standard error, and the command exits with code 2.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
console("--unknown")
```

## Use it from Python

```{python}
from hello_world_python_library import GREETING, greet

print(greet())
print(greet() == GREETING)
```
